Name: Abdon, Son of Jehiel
Summary: Firstborn son of Jehiel the father of Gibeon.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:30; 1 Chronicles 9:36: Firstborn son of Jehiel the father of Gibeon.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Abdon stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
